episodes.synopsis: Having joined forces with Swen and sworn revenge, Rua agrees to serve as the "Rose Princess" at the birthday festival as part of their plan.
episodes.title: If You're Going To Strike Back...

episodes.synopsis: Upon hearing Rua practicing the assigned piece, Nerune rushes into the piano room. Rua, facing Nerune’s hostility, declares that she has no intention of stepping down from the role of the Rose Princess. Finally, the curtain rises on the Birthday Festival.
episodes.title: The Birthday Celebration Begins

episodes.synopsis: While going around distributing roses, Rua runs into Charlotte in the city and learns about the customs the townspeople observe during the Festival of Birth. On the second day of the festival, she browses the market stalls during a brief moment of free time and unexpectedly encounters someone she knows.
episodes.title: Birthday Celebration: Final Day

episodes.synopsis: On the final night of the birthday festival, Rua begins her performance. Meanwhile, Nerune is seen having tampered with the stage. Swen appears and quietly informs her that he is fully aware of everything she has done.
episodes.title: A Yellow Rose, or a White Rose

episodes.synopsis: Delighted with the perfume he was gifted, Swen tells Rua that there is something he wishes to discuss with her once his revenge is complete. As the days pass peacefully following the conclusion of the birthday festival, Rua—thanks to arrangements made by Diana—visits the Peridot ducal residence to learn the truth about her family’s death.
episodes.title: A Promise Between the Two

episodes.synopsis: The story shifts back to her childhood—at the Restat estate, Rua spent peaceful days with her younger brother, Luit, and her parents. One day, her mother arranged for Rua alone to stay overnight at the residence of a neighboring lord. While accompanying her, Louise—on her way back through the woods to retrieve a forgotten item—overheard a conversation between two strangers.
episodes.title: Tragedy

episodes.synopsis: To uncover the truth hidden within her mother’s final testament, Rua resolves to head to her family’s former estate—the old residence of Baron Restat. Meanwhile, Garrot begins to harbor doubts regarding his relationship with Arian, the person who once saved him in the past.
episodes.title: To the Restat Household

episodes.synopsis: Lua and Louise head to the former baron’s mansion to uncover the truth, but encounter an unexpected situation in the forest along the way. Using their own powers and knowledge to escape danger, the two arrive safely at their destination. As they investigate the dilapidated mansion, they discover a clue that could lead them to the truth.
episodes.title: How to Use Your Powers

episodes.synopsis: After finding a diary inside the music box’s mechanism, Lua and the others learn that their mother once suspected the high priests. Reading about the truth behind her family’s horrific deaths and her mother’s anguish in the diary, Lua renews her resolve.
episodes.title: Applause in Broad Daylight
